meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude 会为选定的 NanoClaw 代理组添加 Tavily 的远程搜索和网页提取工具，无需 API 密钥。工具将以 mcp__tavily__ 开头，并在配额耗尽时提供升级指引。
howto.when: 当你想在没有 API 密钥的情况下，给 NanoClaw 的代理组安装 Tavily 网络搜索或 URL 提取功能时触发。

say.text: 给我的‘代码助手’组添加 Tavily 搜索和无密钥的网页提取。
给‘研究组’配置 Tavily 时，只保留搜索和提取，忽略其他工具。
say.note: 技能会自动设置忽略项。

say.text: Tavily 免费配额用完后，请引导我设置付费 API 密钥。
say.note: 技能会检查升级路径并给出指引。

howto.what_en: Installing this skill makes Claude add Tavily's remote Search and Extract tools to selected NanoClaw agent groups, without needing an API key. When the keyless quota runs out, it also sets up an upgrade path for a paid key.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to install Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key for NanoClaw agent groups.

say_en.text: Add Tavily Search and keyless web extraction to my 'code-assistant' group.
say_en.note: The skill installs and registers the tools.

say_en.text: Configure Tavily for the 'research' group, keeping only Search and Extract.
Guide me to set up a paid API key after Tavily quota runs out.
say_en.note: The skill uses the pre-installed upgrade link.
